description: Unit test class 'HardcodedColorDetectorTest' for the 'HardcodedColorDetector' lint rule; testing detection of hardcoded color values across various Android resource XML files.

classes.name: HardcodedColorDetectorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the HardcodedColorDetector, verifying detection of hardcoded colors in Android resource files.

methods.name: getDetector
methods.description: Returns an instance of the detector being tested, HardcodedColorDetector.

methods.name: getIssues
methods.description: Returns the list of issues (linter checks) that this test verifies, specifically HardcodedColorDetector.ISSUE.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Provides test configuration, enabling specific issues for testing.

methods.name: testHardcodeColorInSelector
methods.description: Tests detection of hardcoded color in a selector XML resource.

methods.name: testHardcodeColorInLayout
methods.description: Tests detection of hardcoded colors in layout XML files.

methods.name: testHardcodeColorInStyle
methods.description: Tests detection of hardcoded colors within style XML resources.

methods.name: testIndirectedColor
methods.description: Tests detection when colors are referenced indirectly via color resources.

methods.name: testHardcodeColorInColorElement

methods.name: testHardcodeColorInVectorDrawable
methods.description: Tests detection of hardcoded colors used in vector drawable files.
